title: Query string determined by its cells
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes and let $w$ be a finite word. Suppose that at each position $i$ with $0\le i<|w|$, the query tape contains the $i$-th symbol of $w$, and that the cell at position $|w|$ is blank. Then the query string of $c$ is $w$.
